results.title: RUDRA
results.overview: Five boys gather one night and decide to pull up a prank on someone's father. Things go wrong when the prank turns into a nightmare.

results.name: Rudra: The Edge Of Darkness
results.overview: Set in the Special Crimes Unit of the Mumbai Police, Revolving around DCP Rudraveer Singh, who is under the system’s radar despite being one of its best minds at work.

results.title: Rudra Thandavam
results.overview: Rudran, a fearless cop who battles against drug mafia, gets trapped in a PCR (Protection of Civil Rights) case, unfortunately. Will he prove himself innocent?

known_for.title: Manichitrathazhu
known_for.overview: A young couple, Ganga and Nakulan, arrives at the ancestral home called Madampalli of the latter. Hailing from a family that follows tradition and superstitions, Nakulan's uncle Thampi objects to the couple's idea of moving into the allegedly haunted mansion, which Nakulan ignores. The couple moves in anyway following which seemingly supernatural events begin to happen.

known_for.title: Pavithram
known_for.overview: A young man's relationship with his career, fiancee and brother is brought under stress by the birth of an unexpected sister. The film deals with the relationship between siblings Unnikrishnan and Meenakshi who have an almost 30 year age difference between them.

known_for.title: Dhruvam
known_for.overview: Veerasimha Mannadiar gets killed by Hyder Marakkar, a notorious criminal. Thereafter, Veerasimha's brother, Narasimha Mannadiar, decides to avenge Veerasimha's death.

results.title: Rudra Tandava
results.overview: Rudra Tandava follows a timid young man who has a loving family. When his brother, a government official, is murdered, the protagonist and his father plans to take revenge in their own separate ways.

known_for.title: Oho Enthan Baby
known_for.overview: Ashwin goes to actor Vishnu Vishal’s office to pitch a script and ends up narrating his love story. What the actor thinks to be an interval is Ashwin’s climax, it actually is a stoic end to his romantic relationship with Meera. With Vishnu Vishal’s pursual, Ashwin must confront his former lover again, to complete his story and begin his debut directorial.

known_for.title: Plot No. 666
known_for.overview: Six people go through the trauma of their lives as they come onto an abandoned piece of property known as "Plot No. 666." Being a restricted area because it is the site of many people's deaths, the local villagers fear coming to this area.

known_for.title: A Day in the Life of Anil Bagchi
known_for.overview: A Hindu man caught in the midst of the Bangladesh Liberation War of 1971 risks his life to see his sister.

results.title: Rudra Simhasanam
results.overview: Rudra Simhan is a yogi who gave up all worldly pleasures by listening to the call of his soul. When he returnd to his homeland after a long journey, he comes in to the life of Haimavathi.

known_for.title: Major
known_for.overview: This biopic follows the life of Indian Army officer Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, from his childhood to his heroic actions during the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

known_for.title: Bhamakalapam 2
known_for.overview: A wealthy hotelier disrupts Anupama's life. In retaliation, she puts together an imperfectly perfect team to pull off an elaborate heist at his luxurious hotel during a culinary competition.

known_for.title: Wild Dog
known_for.overview: Wild Dog aka Vijay Varma is an NIA agent who’s brought back to field from a desk job to handle a terrorism case. Despite having a personal motive, he moves heaven and earth to ensure justice is served for the sake of the country.

known_for.title: Peddi
known_for.overview: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

known_for.title: The Dark Knight
known_for.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

known_for.title: Wanted
known_for.overview: Doormat Wesley Gibson is an office worker whose life is going nowhere. He meets an attractive woman named Fox and discovers that his recently murdered father - whom Wesley never knew - belonged to the Fraternity, a secret society of assassins which takes its orders from Fate itself. Fox and Sloan, the Fraternity's leader, teach Wesley, through intense training, to tap into dormant powers and hone his innate killing skills. Though he enjoys his newfound abilities, he begins to suspect that there is more to the Fraternity than meets the eye.

known_for.title: The Unborn
known_for.overview: A young woman fights the spirit that is slowly taking possession of her.

known_for.title: Aunty
known_for.overview: The story revolves around three young men who fall in love with a pretty older woman who had moved into their neighbourhood.

known_for.name: Kullfi Kumarr Bajewala
known_for.overview: Sweet, cute and completely charming, Kulfi is a singing prodigy, who is blessed with a nightingale’s voice. After a tragedy strikes, she ventures out on a new journey to find her estranged father.

known_for.title: Bhadaas
known_for.overview: A detective with training in criminal psychology aids the local police's hunt for a female serial killer who seduces unfaithful husbands before murdering them.

known_for.title: Ranbanka
known_for.overview: Rahul, a young man, tries to protect his wife from a goon who wants to forcibly marry her. When all things go against Rahul, he becomes an angry man, and sets out to fight against the goon.

known_for.title: Paro Pinaki Ki Kahani
known_for.overview: A manhole cleaner and vegetable vendor fall in love during secret meetings in a train bathroom. When she stops appearing, he begins a dangerous search to find her.

known_for.title: Pied
known_for.overview: A young woman with vitiligo faces the same social ostracism as the village's untouchables, and as her family desperately searches for a husband willing to accept her, she discovers rare compassion in the one man who sees her beyond her skin.

results.title: Rudra Garuda Purana
results.overview: The story delves into the mystery of a bus accident that occurred 25 years ago, claiming the lives of all its passengers. In a shocking twist, the same bus and its passengers reappear years later, sparking an intense investigation. The bus named "17A Kaveri Express" forms the center character in the plot.

results.title: Rudra Naari
results.overview: Shekar secretly takes acting lessons and falls in love with his classmate without letting his strict father know about it. But what happens when he finds out?
